artists.biography:
Everything but the Girl (often shortened EBTG) was a two-person English band, formed in Hull during 1982, consisting of lead singer and occasional guitarist Tracey Thorn and guitarist, keyboardist, and singer Ben Watt. The duo's most successful single was a Todd Terry remix of "Missing" charting in several countries in 1994.
They are currently inactive, although vocalist Tracey Thorn hinted that they may perform again someday. They have not performed publicly since 2000.
Watt and Thorn are also a couple; they are very private about their relationship and personal life. For some time, it was not a publicised fact that they were a couple, or that they had married subsequently. The duo have expressed a strong desire to raise their three children with as much privacy as possible.

perplexity.description:
The Best Of Everything But The Girl, released on November 14, 2025, via Buzzin' Fly/Chrysalis, is a definitive 16-track compilation spanning over four decades of the UK duo's career. It captures their evolution from the indie jazz-folk textures of their 1982 debut Night and Day to the contemporary electronic soundscapes of their 2023 album Fuse. The collection includes seminal hits such as the globally successful "Missing" (Todd Terry Remix), "Walking Wounded," and "Nothing Left To Lose," alongside deep cuts that highlight their pioneering blend of electronic, jazz, and pop elements.

Musically, the album reflects Everything But The Girl’s versatility, balancing upbeat electronic club tracks with intimate ballads, arranged to create a journey from modern dancefloor sounds back to their early acoustic roots. This sequencing mirrors the duo’s artistic trajectory and offers a comprehensive overview of their stylistic shifts. Critically, the compilation has been well received for its thoughtful curation and high-quality mastering by Miles Showell at Abbey Road Studios, underscoring the duo’s enduring influence and commercial success, including Fuse reaching No. 3 on the UK Album Chart and winning the MPG Self-Producing Artist of the Year award in 2024.

title: The Best Of Everything But The Girl
